results.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Curl Over Incline Bench
instructions: Stand behind an incline bench set at a 45-degree angle, holding a dumbbell in your right hand using an underhand grip (palm facing up). Place your right arm over the bench so your upper arm rests against the incline pad.
Keep your upper arm stationary and your elbow slightly bent. Curl the dumbbell upward towards your shoulder by bending your elbow, focusing on engaging your biceps.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, ensuring the dumbbell reaches shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arm. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left arm.
tips: Focus on isolating the biceps, minimizing movement in your shoulder and upper arm.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbow to avoid locking out the joint.
Breathe out as you curl the dumbbell and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Curl Over Incline Bench is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Preacher Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand. Position yourself behind a preacher bench and place the back of your upper arm on the bench arm pad.
Start with your arm fully extended and the dumbbell in a supinated grip (palm facing up).
Curl the dumbbell upward towards your shoulder by bending your elbow, keeping the back of your arm pressed against the bench.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arm. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
tips: Keep your upper arm firmly pressed against the bench to isolate the biceps.
Avoid using momentum to lift the dumbbell; focus on controlled movements.
Exhale as you curl the dumbbell up and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Preacher Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Let your arms hang straight by your sides.
Keep your upper arms stationary and curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders by bending your elbows while rotating your wrists so your palms face down.
Squeeze your biceps muscles at the peak of the movement, ensuring the dumbbells reach shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms close to your body and stationary throughout the exercise.
Avoid swinging the dumbbells; focus on controlled movements.
Exhale as you curl the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Reverse Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Simultaneous Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Let your arms hang straight by your sides.
Keep your upper arms stationary and curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders by bending your elbows while rotating your wrists so your palms face up.
Squeeze your biceps muscles at the peak of the movement, ensuring the dumbbells reach shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired repetition.
tips: Keep your upper arms close to your body and stationary throughout the exercise.
Avoid swinging the dumbbells; focus on controlled movements.
Exhale as you curl the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Simultaneous Biceps Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Wide Simultaneous Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing slightly outwards and your arms extended down by your sides. Position your arms slightly wider than your shoulders.
Curl both dumbbells diagonally upward simultaneously by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement when the dumbbells reach shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary; only your forearms should move.
Avoid swinging the dumbbells; use a controlled motion.
Exhale as you curl the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Wide Simultaneous Biceps Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Waiter Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands vertically and elbows close to your body.
Curl the dumbbell upwards towards your chest by bending your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, ensuring the dumbbell reaches shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on moving the weight with your biceps, avoiding momentum.
Exhale as you curl the dumbbell upward and inhale as you lower it.
Keep your elbows close to your body throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Waiter Biceps Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip (palms facing forward) and arms fully extended by your sides.
Keep your upper arms stationary as you curl the dumbbells upwards towards your shoulders by bending your elbows.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists to turn your palms downward (overhand grip), then lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control.
Rotate your wrists back to the underhand grip at the bottom, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on moving the weight with your biceps, avoiding momentum.
Keep your elbows close to your body throughout the exercise.
Ensure smooth and controlled wrist rotation at the top of the curl.
results.description: Dumbbell Zottman Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Zottman Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip (palms facing up). Position your upper arms on the preacher bench pad and fully extend your arms.
Curl the dumbbells upwards towards your shoulders by bending your elbows.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists to turn your palms downward (overhand grip), then lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control.
Rotate your wrists back to the underhand grip at the bottom, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms pressed against the pad to isolate the biceps.
Focus on a full range of motion for maximum muscle activation.
Perform the exercise slowly to increase time under tension.
results.description: Dumbbell Zottman Preacher Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: EZ Bar Biceps Curl Close Grip
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding an EZ bar with hands closer than shoulder-width, palms facing forward, and your arms fully extended down.
Curl the EZ bar towards your chest by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary and close to your body.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, ensuring the bar reaches shoulder height.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on engaging your biceps throughout the movement.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize biceps activation and reduce injury risk.
Exhale as you curl the bar up and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: EZ Bar Biceps Curl Close Grip is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with an ez barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, ensuring the bar reaches shoulder height.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
